column3: He wants to come home. If you leave him where he is, I don't think he'll be around much longer.
Are you listening to what I'm saying?!
This is your own father I'm talking about!
Is he...Is he doing all right?
No he's not. As a matter of fact, he looks ill.
I'm sure you two must have had some problems, but he's still your father, right?
Thank you for taking the trouble of informing me of the situation, investigator.
Despite how poorly you've treated him, your father still calls out your name everyday.
He's in the South Itayado area of the SN district. Go and take him home.
Yes. I will! I'm leaving right now...
Thank me by taking good care of your dad this time.
You did a good thing, Gillian.
Thanks for calling! Will you be my friend?
Thanks for calling me! I'm so happy...!
Thanks for calling me and don't forget to tell your friends to call too!
No answer, huh? Let's hang up.
Hey mister, wanna have some fun?
That's exactly what makes it exciting, isn't it?
I guess that's how it goes...
It's a high-tech world now, so this kind of thing really gets to you.
How about it, mister? Wanna do it with me?
We both want the same thing, right?
That's the going rate. Such a cheapskate.
Cheapskate? You call me a cheapskate?!
I'll be the one to hang up!
...Let's just stop here? I'll hang up.
Surprisingly calm about it, aren't you?
You too?! Not you as well!!
Gillian, in a way I've reconsidered my opinion of you.
What'll you do? Wanna give it a try?
A quiz, huh? Said something about winning a fancy prize?
Isn't that just a lucky streak?
Damn! Did I get it wrong?!
So it's true you bought the Pilot Disk?
Huh? Didn't I just hear a voice?
Not the fancy prize, but... another quiz?
Anyway, let's hang up for now.
Is it okay to just hang up like this?
No need to worry, I remember this line's number.
Not the fancy prize, but... oh well.
Yeah, yeah, I get it already...
Damn! Did I get it wrong?!
Hasn't this service already been busted and shut down?
Hey!! Metal?! You hung up on me?!
What a waste! I'll pick up right where I left off.
You were deceived? Women will do that if you give them the chance.
It was just a "Stella the Stegasaur" talk line. Do you derive some perverse pleasure out of listening to it?
N...No. It's not like that! I just...
Isn't that from a movie or something?
Well, yes. As a matter of fact...
For some reason, I've sort of grown attached to this 'Stella'.
Gillian, I didn't realize you were into that 'weird' stuff!
I like you too Stella!... Stella!!!
Gillian, there is something deeply twisted about you.
Today's Neo Kobe weather forecast. Today will be clear due to a high-pressure system moving in from the south.
But, the National Observatorium has reported that the hole in the ozone layer continues to increase in size.
They recommend that if you're going out of the house, you should liberally apply a thick coating of "Anti-UV" sunscreen.
The weather is our ally. The increase in Ultra-Violet rays will limit their movement.
We should continue the investigation while this weather holds.
Neo Kobe weather for the day will be as follows...
Acid rain will fall sometime during the morning hours, clearing up by the afternoon.
Finally it looks like the weather is gonna improve.
Tomorrow's Neo Kobe weather will be as follows...
Radioactive 'heavy rain' will continue to fall throughout the day, making things a little gloomy. And in some areas, we have a SNOW-9 warning in effect.
Rain, huh? It really gives me the blues!
Neo Kobe has an abundance of rainfall this time of the year.
Rain again!? When is it ever gonna clear up?
Gillian, don't call the Fire Department if you have no reason to.
Its very wrong to make a prank call to the fire department.
This is Miss Hayasaka at Konami. Thanks for your continued support.
Finally, Konami's famous "SNATCHER" will be released worldwide. We're so happy that Konami fans and fanatics will now be able to play this game.

Although the characters in this game are all fictitious, after playing the game, I really felt that I knew the characters as real people. Also, this is the first game I've ever played that continually gave me strong feelings, just like watching a great movie.
I even got to appear on TV, and even showed up on the Pilot Disk...
Oh, that reminds me... did everyone buy the Pilot Disk?
If you did, that would make Hayasaka even happier...!
I'm sure everyone has seen a movie, read a book, or heard music that stays with you and that you never forget. "SNATCHER" is that type of work. I hope it is for you too.
I'm very grateful that I was able to meet all of you in this game and I want to continue helping to bring you exciting and moving software, so keep rooting for us.
Just to thank you for calling all the time, I'm going to let you in on some super-secret information.
I'm going to tell you the videophone number of Konami HQ's R&D Information.
Once again, thanks for calling. I'll tell you one more secret.
The R&D staff data is all available on Jordan.
You can even find out all about me!
Yes. Assistant Director Inoue has a wife.
Grr, cheeky for a lowly underling! And here I'm even separated!
Please calm down. He's probably cooped up at the office anyway. He can't do a thing.
That's right. I haven't even seen my husband's face lately...
Now, now, calm down... just leave a guy like that be, and go out and have some fun.
I'll do that. Thank you so much.
Hi, this is Mitsuhiro Togo. I've just stepped out to the 7-11. If you want, please leave a message and I'll get back to you.
I finally got off work and came home, and my wife's not here. Grrr!!
That wife of mine... she still hasn't come home.
Is it really okay to say things that could break up someone else's family?
It's fine. They say misery loves company.
...Gillian, do you hold some kind of grudge against that AD?
My advice earlier really worked, huh?
Did you hear that, Metal? Total success.
I bought a new car recently.
Currently looking for a cute girl to sit in the passenger seat.
I'm away right now, so try again later. I'll be waiting!
But I just scraped the whole passenger door. And it's only got 500km on it...
Figures, coming from a disciple of the Crash King.
I'm sending it in for repairs, so hang tight a while.
Come on, that's enough about that already...
There's been a lot going on, but...
Once again, looking for a cute girl to sit in the passenger seat.
Hello. Oh, mom, phone for you!
Uh-huh, oh, is that so. Got it. Well, if you'll excuse me, I'll go pee now.
It's always me... no way out of it.
I'm gonna head over to Dr. Hiromoto's place for a bit.
Go play with Yanai for a while?
Say hi to your wife for me.
I think he's gone to Dr. Hiromoto's to shoot the breeze...
I'll tell you the quiz answer. I look like Agnes Lamune, apparently...
Itcho, hurry up and come home?
No... it's not Matsubana. It's Matsuhana. No dots on it.
Matsu as in pine tree, Hana as in flower field.
Not 'wait-nose'. Pleased to meet you. Click!!
I'm at the insurance office right now about last week's accident.
Please get back to me later. ...Beep!!
Oh, this is Matsuhana. Sorry about the other day.
...No no, that parking lot accident last month is all settled now.
The one where the bicycle crashed into me on Awaji Island? That kid's doing fine now, I hear.
The rice-paddy runaway incident in February went fine too. Well, my whole bonus got drained, but...
Oh. The car break-in... I got my bag back, at least.
Though they cleaned out all the cash first, of course...
The broken leg from the truck collision two years back? Yeah, it's healed up fine, thanks to you.
And then just the other day my battery died on me.
While taking it out, some battery fluid got on my jeans and dissolved them right through.
I really am an insurance agent's nightmare, aren't I. Even I have to laugh. Hahahaha. Click!!
...This is Matsuhana. Let me give you the answer to Quiz 2.
Number of accidents: 8 times. Number of narrow escapes: 2 times.
My wild new book is on sale now.
A demonic gun that'll blow your mind away!!
As long as you're holding onto that, there's no way you'll forget me.
If we say goodbye now, while I still feel the same as when I said I loved you...
You like me that much, huh?
...Hide, turn the TV off when it's over, okay!
Will you come flying to me when I'm lonely at night?
If I call you from the top of the Himalayas and ask you to come get me, will you come?
If you don't get to bed soon you'll be late tomorrow, you know?
Come on, right when we're about to start, what's with that face...
Right, we should toast to my departure.
Live a little smarter, will you.
Hide!! Seriously, turn the TV off already!
If anything, I've gotten even more beautiful, haven't I?
Gillian, you shoudn't call if you have no reason.
Gillian, you have no business calling them for no reason!
Please clearly explain your situation in 30 seconds or less.
The computer in Junker HQ will process and respond urgently to your situation.
Please speak in a calm, clear voice.
Konami R&D Information... May I help you?
I'll tell you some top-secret information that nobody else knows.
It took a long time, but "Sparkster" for Genesis and SNES has been completed.
Also, that cool cartoon, Animaniacs is now coming to on Genesis and SNES.
And don't forget about "Biker Mice from Mars" on SNES.
You'll also want to see our "Tiny Toons Sports" games for Genesis and SNES.
We're anxiously awaiting your fan letters!
There is too much interference. I can't transmit.
Too many tall buildings in the area.
There is too much electrical interference. I can't call from here.
In Neo Kobe, even electric waves are unsafe...!
The electrical waves are still unsecure. We cannot call from here.
